problem: A dependency-only pull request can be misclassified as cheap/non-runtime work and skip the scanner that is specifically needed to evaluate new vulnerable dependency state.
invariant: Dependency manifests, lockfiles, package-manager overrides and dependency-security configuration always route to the full dependency/security evidence set, regardless of whether product source code changed.
evidence: 4VELO PR #404 dependency advisories and fail-closed Trivy routing
Gumball docs-only security planner already classifies every non-doc path as full
Gumball v0.7 adds explicit regression tests for manifest and lockfile routing
failure_behavior: Fail closed to full security when dependency-affecting paths change; never silently inherit a docs/light lane.
